Key Findings

  • Initial access through a reused VPN credential without MFA.
  • Domain admin obtained from a plaintext password in an IT share.
  • Production database backups stored on a file server reachable from the office network.
  • Client data from multiple insurers held in shared storage without segregation.
  • Regulators and data subjects will be notified under POPIA at publication.

Data Obtained

  • Policyholder records (ID numbers, contact details, banking details)
  • Claims files, assessor reports and supporting documents
  • Underwriting and pricing models
  • Platform source code and CI/CD secrets
  • Broker and insurer client contracts
  • HR, payroll and employee records
  • Finance: management accounts, audit working papers, tax
